title: Development and external validation of temporal fusion transformer models for continuous intraoperative blood pressure forecasting.
summary: A temporal fusion transformer forecast continuous intraoperative blood pressure and was evaluated on separate patient/database records; sparse measurements, forward filling and treatment-response confounding limit interpretation, and no causal medication effect is established.
ai_technology: A temporal fusion transformer forecasts continuous intraoperative blood pressure from physiological measurements; the study evaluates transfer across separate patient/database records.

evidence.unknown: The datasets and sparse measurements with forward-filled values limit transfer to other operating settings; treatment-response confounding means forecasts do not establish causal effects of vasoactive medication.
